title: Research and Technical Presentation
objectives:
In this course, students learn systematic research methods and techniques, and skills in presenting
scientific and technical materials. By choosing a subject, students must go through various stages
of compilation and submit a written presentation for it, and in doing so, use information networks
and computer publishing tools. In this course, students will learn the importance and role of
rhetoric in mass communication and will be able to strengthen their sense of self-confidence by
presenting oral material. Students learn different styles of expression and eloquence and gain the
ability to analyze, critique, and evaluate different types of oral communication. Students must
provide several lecture sessions in the classroom.
